name: Sysmique Locked
author: Jakerz95
description: Hold between the structure and spike as the wave at 45.4%. Navigate though the following gameplay until 47% where you can hold to the ceiling. Stay at the ceiling until 74% where you can move down, get the mini portal and then hold back to the ceiling. Fall back down at 76%, play through the gameplay at 77% as the mini wave to reenter the level. Play normally from there.
